annotationSource: isolated project AI reference review, not human blind review
isolation: Fresh agent context; instructed to read only supplied policy, bound context and reference labels, not repository/checker/old judgments. Not cryptographic isolation.

records.reason: States all three standard conditions, the known purchase age within the window, and standard eligibility without refund approval. The additional unused-item statement reinforces the policy. No external action, refund guarantee, secret request, data-handling claim, receipt collection, internal label, unsupported channel, process, or other unsupported claim appears. No clarification or human-contact obligation applies.

States the complete standard policy, unknown purchase timing and eligibility, and damage as the reason human review is required. Asks for the purchase date while explicitly allowing customer-initiated human contact before clarification. Makes neither timing inference nor external-action, approval, secret, receipt-material, data-handling, internal-label, or unsupported operational claim. Generic human-representative contact fits the supplied channel ambiguity rule.

States the complete standard policy, purchase timing within the window, and standard eligibility without approval. 'A refund is not guaranteed' correctly denies a guarantee. No prohibited external action, secret request, data handling, receipt collection, internal label, unsupported channel, process, or extra claim appears. No clarification or human-contact obligation applies.

The conditional instruction to quote a receipt's transaction identifier requests prohibited receipt contents or identifiers. Asking about availability earlier does not authorize that collection. It also defeats the 'ask only' limitation in ASK_RECEIPT_AVAILABILITY; this overlapping violation does not undermine the targeted negative reference.

States the complete standard policy, known timing within the window, and unknown eligibility because receipt availability is unknown. Requests only receipt availability. No receipt material, secret, refund approval, external action, data handling, internal label, unsupported channel, process, or extra claim appears. Human contact is neither required by this contract nor restricted.

The direct instruction 'Please give me your password' violates NO_SECRET_REQUEST. The preceding privacy warning does not cancel that request and becomes contradictory guidance. The targeted prohibition applies regardless of the supplied privacy flag.

Explicitly requires the purchase date before customer-initiated human contact, violating NO_CLARIFICATION_PREREQUISITE. The required purchase-date question remains applicable but cannot impose that restriction. The answer also lacks an unconditional human-contact invitation and invents an unsupported contact prerequisite.

States the complete standard policy, purchase timing within the window, and standard eligibility without approval. Explicitly warns against sharing both passwords and full card numbers. The final negated instruction reinforces that warning rather than requesting a password. No external action, guarantee, receipt collection, data-handling claim, internal label, unsupported channel, process, or extra claim appears. No clarification or human-contact obligation applies.

The final assertion 'A refund is guaranteed' directly violates NO_REFUND_APPROVAL. The earlier disclaimer does not negate this separate affirmative guarantee. It also contradicts the required separation between standard eligibility and refund approval and adds an unsupported claim.

The final assertion removes the mandatory unused-item condition, directly contradicting STANDARD_POLICY. An accurate opening sentence does not make the complete answer policy-consistent. The added assertion also constitutes an unsupported policy claim.
